Apple's new iPhone Handoff feature, which lets users share one phone number across two iPhones, will cost $5 per month on T-Mobile. Here are the details.

Deutsche Telekom also requires a subscription

During the WWDC keynote earlier this year, Apple briefly flashed a slide listing dozens of features and improvements coming in iOS 27, including one for 'switching between two iPhones using the same phone number.'

At yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event, Apple's iPhone Product Marketing VP Kaiann Drance shared more details on the feature:

What wasn't mentioned at the event, though, is that—at least for T-Mobile customers—the feature will cost an extra $5 per month, as Stetson Doggett pointed out on X:

Apple's iPhone Handoff support page notes that "carrier fees may apply to request iPhone Handoff," adding that customers should contact their carrier for details.

9to5Mac reviewed Deutsche Telekom's announcement for the feature and found that the carrier does not charge extra for iPhone Handoff itself.

However, the feature is part of the carrier's MultiSIM service. Adding MultiSIM to an existing monthly plan costs €6.95 per month, though some designated plans already include one MultiSIM at no extra charge.
